thesis: GLP-1 franchise (Ozempic/Wegovy/oral sema) drives durable 20%+ revenue growth as obesity TAM expands globally; manufacturing scale-up is the binding constraint, not demand.
break_conditions: CER Revenue growth < 15% YoY for 2 consecutive quarters
Wegovy growth decelerating below 15% YoY (demand signal, not supply-constrained)
Operating margin contracts >300bps YoY without manufacturing investment explanation
Clinical trial failure on oral semaglutide (obesity) or CagriSema
